bindle.compare: Makeshift suitcase: +2 carry for 2 trips (the suitcase gives +3 for good)
bindle.name: Bedsheet Bindle
bindle.purpose: Carry more home from a trip.

bottle_filter.compare: Makeshift purifier: 3 jugs of dirty water become water
bottle_filter.name: Bottle Filter

door_barricade.compare: Makeshift padlock: stops one raid 60% of the time, then breaks (the padlock stops 100%)
door_barricade.name: Door Barricade
door_barricade.purpose: Holds the hatch against one raid.

patch_job.compare: Makeshift repair: 1 more use (a manual repair restores it fully)
patch_job.name: Patch Job
patch_job.purpose: Gets a broken item working one more time.

phone_torch.compare: Makeshift flashlight: 2 uses in dark events; can't signal a rescue
phone_torch.name: Phone Torch

pipe_club.compare: Makeshift axe: stops a raid 50% of the time; 50% chance to break each use
pipe_club.name: Pipe Club
pipe_club.purpose: Something to swing on raid nights.

rag_bandage.compare: Makeshift medkit: cures Injured only (the medkit cures both)
rag_bandage.name: Rag Bandage
rag_bandage.purpose: Closes a wound without the medkit.

rag_respirator.compare: Makeshift gas mask: halves the sickness risk for 2 trips (the gas mask cuts it most)
rag_respirator.name: Rag Respirator
rag_respirator.purpose: Breathe less fallout dust on trips.

scrap_receiver.compare: Makeshift radio: hears broadcasts on half the days; can't transmit, so no rescue
scrap_receiver.name: Scrap Receiver
scrap_receiver.purpose: Hear the news without the radio.

soap_spray.compare: Makeshift bug spray: works 65% of the time, 1 use
soap_spray.name: Soap Spray
soap_spray.purpose: Deal with pests without bug spray.

sock_puppets.compare: Makeshift console: +1 morale for everyone, once (cards and the console can be reused)
sock_puppets.name: Sock Puppet Show

tin_can_alarm.compare: No real equivalent: a silent theft becomes a choice; works twice
tin_can_alarm.name: Tin-Can Alarm
tin_can_alarm.purpose: Wakes everyone when a thief comes at night.
